public_gates: design an outcome-critical selector for matched-current pairs
require continuation margin or success degradation under at least one history intervention
preserve matched-current response/context similarity and source-diverse caps
forbidden_shortcuts: do not change actor input/output contract
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not treat M459 action-only signal as closed-loop proof
hypothesis: M459 found source-diverse matched-current response/action ambiguity but weak continuation outcomes, so the next useful step is to make continuation margin and success degradation first-class selection criteria.
success_criteria: design includes source-diverse compact corpus rules
failure_criteria: design selects pairs only by future response target z-delta
design ignores outcome gate negative result

commands.name: outcome_critical_selector_design
commands.command: Design a matched-current selector that filters by continuation margin/success degradation under history interventions; no training.

decision_rule: M460 is a design milestone. It can admit an implementation of an outcome-critical selector but cannot promote a checkpoint.
next_blocker: pending M460 outcome-critical matched-current selector design
